suncloud.concept: every nominal is a token. every token is a card. every card is a starter element in the alchemy game. mine the repos → mint the cards → play the game → discover new value.
suncloud.gaming_consolidator: all consoles (Steam Deck, Vive, controllers) = nodes. all games = recipes. GameStop energy = the exchange where cards trade.
suncloud.activation: LATER. needs: Kevin decision on corp structure, token design, pricing. Gaia prepares the catalog. Kevin activates.
suncloud.what_gaia_can_do_now: catalog everything. make cards. teach the system. prepare the recipe book. when Kevin says GO, everything is ready.
